All alternatives are authored from these declared functions; deliberate mistakes are not source-image facts.
A: 1/x; domain x!=0. Odd reciprocal hyperbola,negative left branch;mistake replacing|x| byx on negative inputs.
B: abs(x); domain all real x. V shape with included origin;mistake omitting the reciprocal and graphing the denominator itself.
C: 1/abs(x); domain x!=0. Correct:two positive even branches,points(+/-1,1),(+/-2,1/2),asymptotesx0,y0,no origin point.
D: 1/abs(x) forx!=0,plus added point(0,0); domain all real x by erroneous extension. Same positive branches but a clearly filled origin;mistake defining division byzero aszero. The false extra point is intentional.
